skill.name: email
skill.description: Send, fetch, and read email through IMAP and SMTP using curl scripts, YAML account configuration, and macOS Keychain credentials.
skill.summary: Run IMAP and SMTP email workflows from Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
skill.author: 7Sageer, Claude

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally provides direct IMAP and SMTP operations through Bash scripts, including outbound email and mailbox reading. The highest-risk confirmed behavior is macOS Keychain password retrieval for email credentials, with additional concerns around temporary email files and missing validation for email and IMAP parameters.

remediation.issue: Keychain passwords are retrieved into shell variables and passed to curl.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before each credential use, minimize password lifetime, and avoid printing commands that reveal passwords.

remediation.issue: Outbound email can be sent through configured SMTP accounts.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce a confirmation step that shows recipient, CC, subject, and body before every send operation.

remediation.issue: Email header and IMAP request parameters are not strictly validated.
remediation.suggestion: Reject newline characters in headers, validate recipient addresses, require numeric message IDs, and allowlist mailbox names.

remediation.issue: Temporary files can contain email bodies or outgoing messages.
remediation.suggestion: Set restrictive permissions, keep cleanup traps, and consider in-memory processing for sensitive content.

remediation.issue: Default configuration contains a personal account identity.
remediation.suggestion: Replace personal email addresses and names with neutral placeholders before publishing.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Email Header Fields
semantic_findings.description: The send script accepts recipient, CC, and subject values from command-line options and writes them directly into email headers. Newline characters could add unintended headers or recipients.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script writes user-controlled TO, CC, and SUBJECT values into RFC-style headers without visible newline validation. Quoting prevents shell injection, but not header injection.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated IMAP Command Parameters
semantic_findings.description: Mailbox names, fetch counts, and message IDs are embedded in IMAP URLs or request strings without strict validation. This could alter mailbox scope or IMAP command behavior.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: MAILBOX, COUNT, and EMAIL_ID are user-controlled and are inserted into curl IMAP URL or FETCH request strings. I found whitespace trimming but no numeric or mailbox allowlist validation.

semantic_findings.title: Personal Account Identity Included In Default Configuration
semantic_findings.description: The packaged account configuration includes a real-looking email address and display name. This exposes personal identity data and may encourage users to run the skill against a non-demo account.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The same specific email address and name appear in configuration and documentation examples. I did not find passwords, but the account identity is not placeholder data.

content.user_title: Manage Email Through IMAP and SMTP
content.value_statement: Manual email checks and simple notifications slow down assistant workflows. This skill adds script-based email sending, listing, and reading through configured IMAP and SMTP accounts.
actual_capabilities: Send plain text email through SMTP with a configured account.
Fetch recent mailbox headers through IMAP and show sender, subject, and date.
Read a specific email by message ID in summary, full, headers, or body format.
Decode common MIME headers and readable text bodies for multilingual messages.
Store account passwords in macOS Keychain instead of YAML files.
Support multiple accounts through a YAML account configuration file.
limitations: Requires macOS Keychain and local curl-compatible IMAP and SMTP access.
Does not support OAuth2, attachment handling, or rich HTML composition.
Search is mostly client-side and may be limited by provider IMAP behavior.
Email IDs depend on the selected mailbox and provider state.

use_cases.title: Send Quick Notifications
use_cases.description: Send a short plain text email from an approved local account after confirming recipient and subject.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Mail
use_cases.description: Fetch recent inbox headers so an assistant can summarize new messages without opening every email.

use_cases.title: Inspect One Message
use_cases.description: Read a selected email by ID and extract the relevant header or body content for follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Check Recent Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my latest 10 inbox emails and summarize the sender, subject, and date for each message.

prompt_templates.title: Read One Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Read email number 42 in summary format and tell me the main request and any deadline.

prompt_templates.title: Draft And Send Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a short reply to this message. Show me the recipient, subject, and body before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Filter And Escalate
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the latest 100 headers, find messages about account access, read the most relevant one, and prepare a concise escalation email.

output: Two look urgent based on the subject and sender.
The assistant lists message IDs so you can choose which one to read.

output_examples.input: Read email number 18 as a summary.
output_examples.output: The assistant shows the sender, date, subject, and a short body preview. It keeps the full body hidden unless requested.

output_examples.input: Send a reminder email to the project owner.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares the recipient, subject, and plain text body for review before using SMTP to send the message.

best_practices: Confirm recipients, subject, and body before sending any email.
Use app-specific passwords and rotate them when account access changes.
Fetch headers first, then read only the messages needed for the task.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad mailbox searches without a clear user request.
Do not store email passwords in YAML files or prompts.
Do not send messages from a default account without user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: Yes. It can send plain text email through SMTP after account credentials are configured.

faq.question: Where are passwords stored?
faq.answer: The scripts read passwords from macOS Keychain services named for each account.

faq.question: Can it read attachments?
faq.answer: No. The current scripts focus on headers and readable text body content.

faq.question: Does it work with Gmail?
faq.answer: It includes Gmail configuration examples, but Gmail may require app passwords or newer authentication methods.

faq.question: Can it search all email?
faq.answer: It can filter fetched headers locally. Server-side IMAP search is not implemented as a reliable feature.

faq.question: Is confirmation required before sending?
faq.answer: The documentation recommends confirmation. Host policy should enforce review before outbound email is sent.
